summary: Validated the two new features on DEMO-DUPLEX: (A) PDF export of filtered issues list grouped by company — backend pytest 7/7 pass (companies key independent of filters, admin PDF with/without company filter, empty-result PDF, PDF embeds thumbnailed JPEG+PNG photos and 'Preuve de levée' line, priority filter, lecteur 403); (B) 3D issue pins on Maquettes BIM and Espace BIM 4D — HTML overlays appear correctly, data-priority = highest priority (critique red for the 2-issue object, haute for the single-issue object), counter shows nb of issues, multi-issue click opens issue-pin-list with items, single-issue click opens IssueSheet directly, viewer-pins-toggle-btn hides/shows the layer, legend renders, pins also render on the /4d route. Lecteur sees neither issues-export-pdf-btn nor issue-new-btn. Cache: IssueSheet invalidates ['issues', pid] which prefix-matches ['issues', pid, 'pins'] → pins auto-refresh on status changes (verified in code).

issues: Pre-existing Radix a11y warnings 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Reported in iteration_4, still present on multi-pin list open (no new occurrence from this feature).
Pre-existing React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (iteration_4). Not introduced by this feature.

critical_code_review_comments: services/issues_report.py: _photo_rows pads last row with empty strings ('') while cells use Paragraph/Image — platypus accepts empty strings but a Paragraph('') would be more idiomatic. Low priority (no visible issue in PDFs).

routers/reports.py:_thumbnails downloads and converts photos sequentially via asyncio.to_thread; for projects with hundreds of photos this becomes slow. Consider asyncio.gather over per-photo tasks. Not blocking for the current demo scope.

IssuePins.jsx: engine.setMarkers() receives nodes resolved via refs; if issue list changes while React re-renders, the next frame may briefly map a stale node to a new gid. In practice invalidation + render order makes this harmless. No action required.
seed_data_creation: Used the 3 issues pre-created by main agent (RES-0001 critique Maçonnerie Durand, RES-0002 basse Plâtrerie Martin, RES-0003 haute Plâtrerie Martin). No new seed data created.
